query: Starting from a W–Cu composite containing W particles or interconnected W ligaments within a Cu matrix, what single intervention could overcome phase separation and interfacial void formation, thereby improving thermal conductivity relative to the untreated composite under heat-transfer and irradiation conditions relevant to joints between W-based plasma-facing materials and Cu-based cooling components? Formulate one hypothesis that states the intervention, the proposed mechanism, the predicted comparative outcome, the applicable processing and service boundaries, supporting prior evidence, and a decisive falsification experiment.

generation.hypothesis: The addition of a small amount of titanium (Ti) as an alloying element to the W-Cu composite can overcome phase separation and interfacial void formation, thereby improving thermal conductivity.
generation.material_initial_state: W-Cu composite containing W particles or interconnected W ligaments within a Cu matrix
generation.intervention: Addition of 2 at.% Ti to the W-Cu composite
generation.conditions: Heat-transfer and irradiation conditions relevant to joints between W-based plasma-facing materials and Cu-based cooling components
generation.structural_mediator: Formation of a Ti-rich interfacial layer
generation.mechanism: The Ti-rich interfacial layer reduces phase separation and interfacial void formation by promoting wetting and bonding between W and Cu
generation.predicted_outcome: Thermal conductivity improvement of at least 15% relative to the untreated composite
generation.boundary: Temperature range: 500-1000 K, Irradiation dose: 1-10 dpa
generation.uncertainty: The actual improvement in thermal conductivity may vary depending on the specific processing and service conditions, as well as the distribution and morphology of the Ti-rich interfacial layer

falsification_experiment.design: Comparative thermal conductivity measurements of Ti-doped and undoped W-Cu composites under heat-transfer and irradiation conditions
falsification_experiment.falsification_rule: If the thermal conductivity of the Ti-doped composite is not at least 10% higher than that of the undoped composite, the hypothesis is falsified
